anomalies.obs: On the EthernetAndPower sheet the battery‑isolation Schottky U4 (SS2040FL) is drawn with its anode (pin 1) tied to NET0025 and its cathode (pin 2) tied to NET0041, which runs to the + terminal of the 18650 holder U9 (pin 1). NET0025 is the BAT+ rail (it also feeds IC2 VIN/EN, USB VBUS J2.1 and barrel‑jack center J5.1). Thus the diode points from BAT+ toward the cell.
anomalies.expected: The spec states the battery diode is oriented 'anode on battery (via U7), cathode on BAT+' so that the cell can feed BAT+ while USB/adapter current cannot back‑feed into the cell.

evidence.quote: U6 (SS2040FL) anode→cathode → BAT+ ... netlist: anode on battery (via U7), cathode on BAT+
EthernetAndPower sheet: U4 SS2040FL pin1→NET0025, pin2→NET0041→U9.1; NET0025 also on IC2.A2(VIN), J2.1(VBUS), J5.1(center)

anomalies.impact: The 18650 cannot power the board (its + is on the diode's cathode), and any USB/DC‑barrel 5 V on BAT+ forward‑biases the reversed diode into the raw cell, the exact back‑feed the diode was meant to block.

anomalies.obs: The barrel‑jack switch contact J5.3 is tied to NET0041 (the battery + side, same net as U4.2/U9.1), while J5.2 is tied to GND. The battery negative (U9.2/U9.3) is tied straight to GND, not to J5.3. The in‑sheet note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug' still applies.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec the jack's internal switch disconnects the battery by breaking the battery‑return path: 'J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT-' so that inserting a plug opens the battery negative. The battery + should not sit on the switch contact.

evidence.quote: Netlist: J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT- ... inserting a DC plug breaks that short — disconnecting the battery
EthernetAndPower sheet: J5 pin2→GND, pin3→NET0041 (battery +); U9 pin2/3→GND directly

anomalies.impact: With no plug inserted the normally‑closed J5.2–J5.3 contact shorts the battery + (NET0041) directly to GND, dead‑shorting the cell; and the jack can no longer act as a battery‑disconnect switch. This reproduces the 'DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY!' condition the spec says was fixed in rev D.

parsed.summary: The battery side of the power section is wired opposite to the specification: the isolation diode U4 is reversed (anode on BAT+, cathode on the cell) and the barrel‑jack switch contact is placed on the battery‑positive net while the cell negative is hard‑tied to GND. Together these prevent the 18650 from powering the board and short the cell to ground when no DC plug is inserted.
